Last Updated: October 26th, 2026

As suggested by [Derek Sivers](https://sive.rs/now), here is a list of the things I'm currently doing or thinking about.

## The 4-Hour Workweek

I've just started my annual re-read of [The 4-Hour Workweek](https://tim.blog/tim-ferriss-books/#the-4-hour-workweek). As one of my all-time favorite books, it is a great reminder of the simple systems that can improve our lives and bring us closer to what matters most.

## Data Science at the Command Line

While I am still working with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/product/claude-code) on a daily basis, I have been getting a tremendous amount of joy writing code by hand, especially in the terminal. I recently stumbled across [Data Science at the Command Line](https://jeroenjanssens.com/dsatcl/) and have started to work my way through it to learn some best practices and pick up some additional tips and tricks along the way.
